column1: # The owner's stress diagram, layer by layer, against what is actually in yeast-GEM v9.0.2 and
# in ystwin. One row per diagram item. Read this file, not the module: the module is a loader,
# a validator and three measurements; the table is the work.
# SIX VERDICTS, and the one that carries the audit is NOT_METABOLIC.
#   IN_GEM           reactions exist in the SHIPPED yeast-GEM. gem_reactions lists their ids.
#   IN_GEM_RESTORED  reactions exist, but a gene the item needs arrives only through
#   IN_MODULE        no GEM reaction of its own; a named ystwin module carries it.
#   NOT_METABOLIC    a regulator with no metabolic reaction. CORRECTLY absent from a metabolic
#                    model -- this is not a gap and must not be counted as one. panel_module
#                    names the ystwin module its pathway is represented by, or "-" when the
#                    pathway itself is unrepresented at the PANEL layer -- a hole of a
#                    different kind from GAP, returned by unrepresented_pathways() and not
#                    by gaps(). Three rows: sensor.GPR1, cascade.PKA_kinases, sensor.SPS.
#   GAP              genuinely missing and closable. The basis states the route.
#   REFUSED          missing, deliberately. The basis states why, and what measurement closes it.
# ABSENCE IS ESTABLISHED BY ORF, NEVER BY SYMBOL. cobrapy leaves Gene.name empty, so a symbol
# lookup on a cobra model returns nothing for every gene and the whole diagram reads as absent.
# The map is built from data/gem/yeast-GEM.xml.gz's own fbc:geneProduct labels by
# fba/stress_genes.py::gene_label_map. Two rows here exist because of that trap: GPX3 IS in the
# model, under its systematic name HYR1 (YIR037W) on r_0483; and RHO1 (YPR165W) -- the CWI
# cascade's terminal GTPase -- IS in the model, as a subunit of 1,3-beta-glucan synthase r_0005.
# A symbol sweep calls both absent and both calls are wrong.
# ORFs are SGD's, resolved from data/external/sgd/gene_association.sgd.gaf.gz (gitignored) and
# data/external/sgd/regulation/*.json (tracked). WSC1 resolves through its alias SLG1, GPX3
# through HYR1, ACE1 through CUP2, CRT1 through RFX1. Every ORF here is SGD's PRIMARY
# systematic name -- the first entry of the GAF synonym field -- never a merged
# gem_reactions ids are yeast-GEM v9.0.2's own, read out of the vendored SBML this session and
# re-checked on every load by verify_coverage(). panel_module is a key of
# generator/stress_panel.py::MODULES. code_module is a dotted ystwin module.
# THIS TABLE AND data/gem/absent_stress_genes.tsv ARE HELD TOGETHER BY ONE INVARIANT: every gene
# stress_genes actually ADDS to the model (verdict GPR_EXTEND or NEW_REACTION, 19 of them) must be
# named by some row here, or a gene was restored for a function nothing represents. It did not
# hold until this pass added adaptation.manganese_homeostasis (SMF2), adaptation.n_glycosylation
# (ALG3) and the four late mannan transferases MNN2/MNN5/MNT2/MNT3. The 20 gene-layer REFUSALS are
# not held to it: seven are the cell-wall cross-linking cluster and have their own REFUSED row
# here; the other thirteen -- CCS1, CYB5, DAP1, ERG28, GLC3, KHA1, MNN4, TOK1, VCX1, VMA21, VMA22,
# VNX1, VPH2 -- are accessory subunits or paralogues of items already represented, and a row
# apiece would be padding. test_every_gene_the_restore_adds_lands_in_some_pathway_row pins both.

Present and priced. stress_ph.constrain_proton_budget restricts r_0227's rule to PMA1/PMA2 (dropping the Golgi apyrase YND1) and closes the free proton sinks so that a cytosolic proton costs 1 ATP -- measured proton_price 1.000000 under the reference batch regime. What binds is the PRICE, not the pump's identity.

Present as two reactions, and they are the model's only ATP-driven TRANSPORT consumers of the cytosolic proton pool: each takes one s_0794 per ATP, where r_0227 takes none and exports the hydrolysis proton to s_0796 instead. column9: yeast-GEM has no membrane AREA and no compartment volume, so ER expansion cannot be represented as itself. Its metabolic cost can: the phospholipid demand is the lipid backbone and lipid chain pseudoreactions, whose masses stress_biomass.set_pool_masses moves. Representing the cost and refusing the geometry is the honest split.

ALG3 transfers the first Dol-P-Man-derived mannose onto Man5GlcNAc2-PP-dolichol; the gene and the reaction are BOTH absent from yeast-GEM and stress_genes adds ALG3_ER. This is the pathway DTT and tunicamycin actually hit -- STRESSORS carries DTT -- and until the restore the model had no glycosylation step for either to act on. MEASURED: blocking ALG3_ER moves growth by 3.3e-08 /h under the shipped default bounds and 3.9e-16 /h at reference batch -- 2.8e-06 and 3.3e-14 of the 0.0117 /h growth SE, so invisible to any growth assay. It is coverage; pricing it would need a measured glycan flux this repository does not have. SGD: GO:0052925 on IDA.

column9: The remodelling half of the cell wall, and the half CWI signalling actually induces. Gas1-5 are beta-1,3-glucanosyltransferases (GO:0042124, IDA for Gas1/2/4/5, ISS for Gas3) and Crh1/Utr2 transfer chitin onto glucan (GO:0016757, IDA and IMP); all seven are absent from yeast-GEM's gene list and all seven are declared REFUSALS in absent_stress_genes.tsv. Refused here for the same structural reason and it is worth stating in pathway terms: a transglycosylase is an ISOMERISATION of the polymer -- same atoms, different linkage -- so its reaction is A -> A in a model whose only glucan species are the two lumped biomass components of r_4048 at 0.73914 and 0.24696 mmol/gDCW. Adding it would create a thermodynamically free cycle carrying no flux, which is worse than the omission. What would close it: distinct yeast-GEM metabolites for nascent and cross-linked glucan, plus one measured cross-linking flux under a named cell-wall stress.

An efflux reaction would export a metabolite that does not exist. What would close it: a named xenobiotic with a yeast-GEM metabolite id and a measured export stoichiometry.

The route to add it is unambiguous -- hydrolyse the protein pseudoreaction r_4047's own amino-acid composition back to free amino acids, which costs nothing to write. It is refused because the RATE is the whole content: an unconstrained protein hydrolysis reaction is a free lunch that lets the model recycle biomass, and no autophagic flux is measured anywhere in this repository. What would close it: one measured autophagic protein degradation rate in mmol amino acid/gDCW/h under a named stress.

The protein pseudoreaction r_4047 is the model's whole proteome, and lethal when blocked. stress_proteostasis.ribosome_allocation_penalty carries the reduction against Metzl-Raz's measured phi_R = 0.35*X + 0.08 with X in GENERATIONS/h -- note the module converts the slope to 0.35/ln(2) per 1/h, because the paper's own axis is generations. The relaxation LAW dmu/dt = mu(mu_ss - mu) is REJECT (REVISED_BUILD_LIST section 3 D4): 0.015x-0.047x the 0.146 floor once the incumbent generator is allowed its own capacity parameter.

bridge/regulation.py::eflux_layer is the map from module activity to reaction bounds. Its own layer-state constant reports it inert, and the number behind that is EFLUX_BOUNDS_TIGHTENED_AT_3X_EC50 = 0: across all 25 stressors and a 31-point dose sweep, every module carrying a transcription factor has minimum activity exactly 0.0, so scale = max(0, 1 + a) >= 1 and the layer only ever RAISES an upper bound. Carried as the honest null arm, not offered as a live regulation route.

THE ONE STRUCTURAL HOLE THIS AUDIT FOUND THAT IS NOT A MISSING REACTION. The repository has zero transcriptional repression anywhere: across 25 stressors there are exactly FIVE negative target weights -- DTT on redox, menadione on nadh, glucose_starvation and antimycin_A on atp, acetic_acid on ph -- and all five are on METABOLITE POOLS, which have no transcription factor and no regulon by construction. Not one regulon is repressed by anything. Gasch's own measurement is roughly half repression. Refused rather than built for the reason at tf.DOT6: forcing a regulon negative by hand is a knockout operator and not a dial, because gene scales add across regulons and a two-regulon 50% repression clips an essential reaction to zero and the model dies. What would close it: a repression coupling with a measured slope, and a bound operator that is multiplicative on capacity rather than additive on activity.
